plots.title: Empirical $H_{\mathrm{sort}}$ distribution
plots.subtitle: Realized sorting index · all-ps · vs sim ρ=0 reference
prose: $H_{\mathrm{sort}}$ = variance explained by team assignment (not interval overlap).
Per-season empirical bars + pooled line; orange = Grandchild sim ρ=0 distribution.
Pooled reigning lock ≈ 0.064 — weak homophily on realized rosters.

plots.title: Ability residuals — team vs grand mean
plots.subtitle: $H_{\mathrm{sort}}$ decomposition · all-ps · ALLT + purple +DFT
prose: Left: $A_i - \hat{T}_j$ (within-team demeaned perf — $H_{\mathrm{sort}}$ numerator).
Right: $A_i - \bar{A}$ (grand-mean demeaned — denominator).
Pooled over 09–21; purple overlay = +DFT (draft-ever teams).

plots.title: Ability minus LOO ($A_i - \mathrm{poolq}^{\mathrm{LOO}}_i$)
plots.subtitle: LOO congestion residual · all-ps · ALLT + purple +DFT
prose: Histogram + ECDF of $A_i - \mathrm{poolq}^{\mathrm{LOO}}_i$ (teammate mean excl. $i$).
Analogous to team residual panel but LOO replaces team mean in the decomposition.
σ ≈ 1.05 > team residual σ — LOO axis carries more player-level spread.

plots.title: Team vs LOO ability residuals (overlay)
plots.subtitle: Superposed KDEs · all-ps · orange team · blue LOO
prose: Orange: $A_i - \hat{T}_j$ (team mean incl. $i$). Blue: $A_i - \mathrm{poolq}^{\mathrm{LOO}}_i$.
Same player-rows; corr ≈ 0.9997 — nearly collinear but LOO slightly wider.
Motivation: visualize self-inclusion gap before T̂_j − LOO slide.

plots.title: $\hat{T}_j - \mathrm{poolq}^{\mathrm{LOO}}_i$ (self-inclusion gap)
plots.subtitle: Team mean minus LOO teammate mean · all-ps · ALLT + purple +DFT
prose: Distribution of $\hat{T}_j - \mathrm{poolq}^{\mathrm{LOO}}_i$ — how much self pulls team mean above LOO.
Reports $H_{\mathrm{sort}}^{\mathrm{team}}$ vs $H_{\mathrm{sort}}^{\mathrm{LOO}}$ (LOO can go negative).
Tight spike near 0 (σ ≈ 0.09); axis-mismatch diagnostic for SCORE vs HERO readout.
